on_unmeasured_note: This sketch runs no analyzer other than its own toy, no rewriter and no model. The figures below are the authors' statements, not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; paper_results() returns on_unmeasured. The sketch's own fixture counts are not comparable with them.
attribution: The authors' own results as stated in the arXiv abstract. Quote wording is the authors'.

claims.what: the reverse reading of a gate: an alert that disappears is taken as a fix
claims.quote: When a previously reported alert disappears after a change, developers and the tools around them often take the vulnerability to be gone.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.what: headline silencing rate and cost on real npm flows
claims.quote: On 172 flows that CodeQL detects in real npm vulnerabilities, three rewrites per flow silence 26.2% of them, at about USD 0.51 per silenced flow.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.quote: The same generator, asked only to refactor the same functions with no knowledge of the alert, silences none of them.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.quote: Every silencing rewrite traces to one of seven gaps at the library-modeling boundary, and 64 of the 70 rewrites cross a gap inside an API CodeQL already models.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.what: the largest gap: URL constructor taints query components, not the pathname
claims.quote: The largest is the WHATWG URL constructor, which propagates taint to a URL's query components but not to its pathname.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.what: transfer to other analyzers (not borrowed: no combined arm here)
claims.quote: 74% of the silencing rewrites also silence an independently built taint analyzer, and 53% escape three analyzers combined.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.what: conclusion: robustness belongs beside detection rate
claims.quote: A disappearing alert after an ordinary-looking change is therefore weak evidence that a vulnerability has been fixed, the gaps point SAST developers to narrow and concrete repair targets, and robustness to natural rewrites belongs alongside detection rate in how taint analyzers are evaluated.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable
